items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And there's Billie Holiday and Sarah Vaughan, singers, you know, and musicians, we'd party.

ctx.x: It's the White Rose, you know? There's a chain of those bars in New York where we'd always go at the

intermission. It was just right around the corner, you know. And we would all go there. And there's Billie Holiday and Sarah Vaughan, singers, you know, and musicians, we'd party. This is a funny industry. We have a -- what do they call it -- something where -- oh, gee whiz. I can't think of the word. But it's a hazard, industrial hazard, you know?
